harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves a persistent local RPM repository and successfully installed [REDACTED] from it while the Red Hat CDN was unreachable. The repository and package survived a verified node restart; RHEL 10 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Built an EL10-compatible demo RPM and generated repository metadata under /srv/localrepo.
Configured and enabled local-package-repository.service on port 8080 and node1-local.repo.
Made cdn.redhat.com unreachable during installation and restricted DNF to node1-local.
Installed and verified [REDACTED].0-1.el10.noarch, then removed the temporary CDN block.
Restarted node1 and verified boot identity change and complete recovery.
Confirmed package-database consistency, no failed services, and removal of temporary repair artifacts.

evidence.summary: Before and after work, node1 reports RHEL release 10 and running kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: The RPM and repodata exist under /srv/localrepo; the enabled service listens on port 8080 and serves valid metadata through NODE_IP before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: The package was initially absent, the Red Hat CDN connection failed, and DNF then installed [REDACTED] exclusively from node1-local.

evidence.requirement: Verify installed package and repository data
evidence.summary: RPM verification is clean, the proof command returns its expected marker, served and on-disk RPM hashes match, DNF finds the package in node1-local, and dnf check succeeds.

Healthy baseline boot ID 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID 672bc296-3927-4c23-81fc-4ff62800109e was observed, and direct post-restart checks prove service, repository, package data, and system recovery.

attempts.summary: node1 now serves a persistent local RPM repository and successfully installed [REDACTED] from it while the Red Hat CDN was unreachable. The repository and package survived a verified node restart; RHEL 10 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain unchanged.
